+++ b/src/click/strict_trailing_uuid_space.py
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+from gettext import gettext as _
+
+from .types import UUIDParameterType
+
+if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from .core import Context
+    from .core import Parameter
+
+
+class StrictTrailingUuidSpace(UUIDParameterType):
+    """Like :class:`~click.types.UUIDParameterType`, but only leading
+    whitespace is stripped. Trailing whitespace is left in place and
+    causes validation to fail.
+    """
+
+    def convert(
+        self, value: t.Any, param: Parameter | None, ctx: Context | None
+    ) -> t.Any:
+        import uuid
+
+        if isinstance(value, uuid.UUID):
+            return value
+
+        value = value.lstrip()
+
+        try:
+            return uuid.UUID(value)
+        except ValueError:
+            self.fail(
+                _("{value!r} is not a valid UUID.").format(value=value), param, ctx
+            )
diff --git a/tests/test_strict_trailing_uuid_space.py b/tests/test_strict_trailing_uuid_space.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..896de81
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_strict_trailing_uuid_space.py
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+import uuid
+
+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.strict_trailing_uuid_space import StrictTrailingUuidSpace
+
+VALUE = "a8ab0c30-1b38-4e7e-9c8f-b2d4a0f1e5d1"
+
+
+def test_leading_whitespace_stripped():
+    assert StrictTrailingUuidSpace().convert(f"  {VALUE}", None, None) == uuid.UUID(
+        VALUE
+    )
+
+
+def test_uuid_passthrough():
+    u = uuid.UUID(VALUE)
+    assert StrictTrailingUuidSpace().convert(u, None, None) is u
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [f"{VALUE} ", f"  {VALUE}\n", "not-a-uuid"])
+def test_trailing_whitespace_rejected(value):
+    with pytest.raises(click.BadParameter, match="is not a valid UUID"):
+        StrictTrailingUuidSpace().convert(value, None, None)
notes:
Added StrictTrailingUuidSpace subclassing UUIDParameterType with convert mirroring the base (same signature, UUID passthrough, fail message) but using lstrip() so trailing whitespace is rejected; base calls no super(), so none is used. Added tests.
